run_geometry_optimization: run a geometry optimization job on an atomic structure using an ASE calculator and optimization flags
run_single_point_energy: run a single-point energy and force calculation on an atomic structure using an ASE calculator
run_conformer_energies: run conformer energy and geometry calculations by optimizing molecular conformers across molecule families

run_ionization_electron_affinity: run unoptimized ionization energy and electron affinity calculations on structures at different charge and spin states
